Other words

  • perspicilla, perspicillōrum n.

    noun, second declension · also used · Renaissance · Traupman; Erasmus; Traupman 312; Traupman 321 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • oculāria, oculārium n. pl.

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · modern · Andresian p. 39 · Declension on Wiktionary

    A noun made from the adjective oculārius, of the eyes (Cels.; Lewis & Short), as in vitra oculāria.

Examples

  • perspicillīs ūtī

    wear glassesTraupman 405

  • Perspicillīs ūtor.

    I wear glasses.Traupman 321
